description: Generate one original song using a Skyfire PAY token scoped to seller service ea133c15-9ed4-4346-ad48-990b10aa1c87. The backend charges $0.50 USDC; it also accepts x402 payments. Supply the Skyfire token privately, never quote it in the answer. Paid calls queue a job; use skyfire_get_music to poll it. Do not retry a paid call without checking its outcome.

skyfireToken.description: Skyfire PAY or KYA-PAY token scoped to the Suede Create Music seller service. Treat as a bearer secret.
